data.name: Gannie
data.gender_notes: Gannie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gennan' meaning 'to beget' or 'to be born'. The name Gannie is a feminine form, evoking images of grace and divine favor. The name Gannie carries the meaning “Graceful, God's Favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gannie usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, god's favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of God's love and grace upon one's life.
data.etymology: Gannie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, God's Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gannie total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: גאני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גאני הוא שם שמקורו בעברית ומשמעותו 'האל שלי הוא אדוני' או 'אלוהים שלי הוא נדיב'. השם גאני קשור לשורש העברי 'גאוה', שפירושו 'גאווה' או 'התנשאות', אך גם קשור ל'גאון', שפירושו 'אלוהים' או 'אדון'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב קהילות יהודיות וגם בקרב נוצרים כהתייחסות לאלוהים כמושיע ומגן.

in_greek.name: Γκαννι
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός μου είναι ο Κύριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Γκαννι είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός μου είναι ο Κύριος' ή 'Ο Θεός μου είναι γενναίος'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται με την έννοια της προστασίας και της σωτηρίας από τον Θεό. Το όνομα Γκαννι έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους ως ένδειξη πίστης και αφοσίωσης στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Gannie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gannie originem habet in lingua hebraica et significat 'Deus meus est dominus' vel 'Deus meus est liberalis'. In traditione christiana, nomen Gannie refertur ad protectionem et salvationem a Deo. Quod nomen usitatum est inter credentes ut signum devotionis et fidei in Deum.

in_english.name: Gannie
in_english.meaning: My God is my lord or God is gracious
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gannie originates from Hebrew roots and means 'My God is my lord' or 'God is gracious'. Etymologically derived from the Hebrew terms for 'God' and 'my lord', it signifies a profound personal relationship with God. Historically, similar names have been used in biblical contexts to denote divine favor and protection. In Christian tradition, Gannie symbolizes faith, divine guidance, and salvation. It is often chosen for its spiritual significance and the personality traits it embodies, such as devotion and trust in God.

In Western culture, this name is associated with motherhood and nurturing, reflecting the aspects of being brought into the world through birth. In certain communities, Gannie may also carry the meaning of a strong and independent woman who embraces new opportunities with courage and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Gannie celebrates the divine process of creation and birth. It reminds us of the infinite love and compassion of the Creator, who birthed each us into the world with a unique purpose. As a Christian name, Gannie offers a reminder to embrace the opportunities for spiritual growth and renewal in our lives, trusting in the grace and favor of God.
